Name: Crystal Crush
Overview:
Crystal Crush is a tile matching puzzle. In the middle of the screen is an arrangement of hex tiles which can be rotated by the player. On the sides are entry points for colored crystals; in all modes but repulse the launch is manually triggered.

The specific goal depends on the playing mode: match three (creating same colored groups of three or more to remove them from the playfield), colour match (there are three big arrangements which need to be filled with correctly colored crystals), repulse (only one color is allowed to be placed; the others need to be deflected by touching them with a placed crystal) and join (the player needs to connect gold crystals by placing silver crystals).

Besides the standard crystals, there are also four special crystals: star (rewards bonus points), diamond (appears after a high combo and destroys all nearby crystals), virus (appears after four consecutive combos and destroys all connected crystals) and skull (game over when placed).
